test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 20 Jun, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank No. 4.
solution:
The correct answer is "nomads."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The reason to use **"nomads"** in the blank is to provide a noun that accurately describes a group of people who frequently move from place to place. (रिक्त स्थान में **"nomads"** का उपयोग करने का कारण एक संज्ञा प्रदान करना है जो उन लोगों के समूह का सटीक वर्णन करता है जो अक्सर एक स्थान से दूसरे स्थान पर जाते रहते हैं।)
 
• Using **"nomads"** in this context effectively communicates that the people being referred to have a lifestyle characterized by constant mobility and lack of permanent settlement.
 
• The correct answer is Option 1.
 
• Correct paragraph:

In the Great Rift Valley of Eritrea, the nomadic people who are in the Atrtribe build their houses of straw. Their houses are shaped like domes__ - half spheres. The homes are small and cool. The people can move their houses when they want to move. Since the people are __**nomads**__, they move often. They ______ (5) ______ their animals to new places in order to find food.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 
• **Lost: **unable to find your way; not knowing where you are. (रास्‍ता खोज पाने में असमर्थ; दिशा-ज्ञान से रहित)
 
• **Creative: **involving the use skill or imagination to make or do new things. (कौशल या कल्‍पना के प्रयोग से रचना करते हुए; रचनात्‍मक, सृजनात्‍मक)
 
• **Ill: **not in good health; not well. (स्‍वस्‍थ नहीं; अस्‍वस्‍थ, बीमार)
